name: Control Chart (Attribute)
description: SPC charts for count data: p, np, c, u
whenToUse: Control-chart counted data: p and np for defectives, c and u for defects, with Nelson-type rules on the plotted points.
typeHint_p: Fraction of defective units per sample. Sample size may vary.
typeHint_np: Number of defective units with constant sample size n.
typeHint_c: Number of defects per unit; inspection opportunity constant.
typeHint_u: Defects per unit; inspection opportunity variable.
sizeHint: Number of inspected units per data point.
constantNHint: Same sample size for every data point.
baselineHint: Empty = use all values as baseline.
noViolations: No rule violations — process is stable.
